errorCodes.meaning: The deposited document's `recipient` is not a DID the VTA holds keys of in `contextId`. The VTA holds only what is addressed to a DID it acts as, in the context that DID belongs to (VTI-NTF-050, VTI-NTF-056).

The deposited document would not have been accepted had it been delivered to the VTA directly: its `type` is not notifications/notify/0.1 or notifications/relay/0.1, it does not validate as a document of that type, its proof does not verify against its `issuer`, it is outside its acceptance window or past its `expiresAt` at the time of the deposit, or — for a relay — a layer of it fails notifications/relay consumer item 2 (VTI-NTF-032, VTI-NTF-042). Nothing of it is held.

ContextId.description: The trust context the notification is held in: the one the addressed DID belongs to.
ContextId.title: ContextId

DepositedDocument.description: The notifications/notify/0.1 or notifications/relay/0.1 document the client received, kept whole and exactly as received — proof included — never restated, re-serialised from a typed form, or re-signed. Deliberately an opaque object, so that every member its issuer signed survives byte for byte for the VTA, and later the principal's client through vta/notifications/show, to verify. Its `recipient` MUST be a DID the VTA holds keys of in `contextId`.
DepositedDocument.title: DepositedDocument

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

NotificationId.description: The originator's identifier for one notification, unique among the notifications that originator issues and the same in every document that carries it — retries, re-issued documents and relayed copies alike. It is the notification's idempotency key (VTI-NTF-021). Compared for equality only. An originator SHOULD make it unguessable and SHOULD NOT make it descriptive: it travels as far as the notification does.
NotificationId.title: NotificationId

Response.description: Receipt of a deposited document the VTA verified, naming the innermost notification. The same whether the VTA held it, declined it under its acceptance policy, or already held the revision, and never saying which (VTI-NTF-023, VTI-NTF-055).

revision.description: The revision of the innermost notification, echoed.

schema.description: A client with standing in a trust context hands its VTA a notifications/notify or notifications/relay document it received for a DID the VTA holds keys of in that context — a persona DID whose mediator socket the client holds — exactly as received, proof included. The VTA verifies and holds it exactly as if the document had been delivered to it directly: the same layer-by-layer verification, the same acceptance policy counting the party that delivered the document and never the depositing client, the same one record per originator and notificationId, and the same receipt whatever it did (VTI-NTF-054 – VTI-NTF-056). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The trust context the addressed DID belongs to, in which the VTA holds the notification if it accepts it.
